levels.title: 문단
items: Who is your favorite artist? What does she or he look like? Some artists painted self-portraits. Why did they paint themselves? Let's find out.
Vincent van Gogh was a Dutch artist. He was not famous in his lifetime. When he was 33, he moved to Paris. He wanted to paint people, but models were too expensive.
He thought, "I don't have money for a model. What can I do?" So, Van Gogh started to paint himself. He painted 36 self-portraits. They are all different.
Frida Kahlo was a Mexican artist. When she was six years old, she was very sick. Her right leg became weaker than her left leg. But she thought, "I will get well. I will help sick people like me."

When she was 18, she was in a terrible bus accident. She stayed in the hospital for a long time. Kahlo said to herself, "I look weak. But I am stronger than anyone." So, Kahlo started to paint herself.
Van Gogh and Kahlo painted themselves for different reasons. But their paintings have one thing in common. They touch the hearts of many people.
Nick Allen was in the fifth grade. One day in English class, he asked his teacher, "How do words get their meanings? Why does the word dog mean a dog? Why can't it mean a book?"
On the way home, Nick saw a pen on the street. He picked up the pen. He had an idea. "From today, your new name is frindle."
The next day, he told his friends about his new word. By the end of the week, all his classmates were using it. "Can I borrow your frindle?" "I think that your red frindle is pretty."
Mrs. Granger took out a letter. She said, "I wrote this letter for you. But I'm not going to give it to you today. I will send you this letter some day."
Time passed and Nick graduated. He forgot about frindle. When he turned 21, he received a package from Mrs. Granger. It had a pen, a letter, and a dictionary.
There was a note on the dictionary. "See page 541." Nick couldn't believe his eyes. On that page, he found the word frindle!

levels.title: 긴 이야기
items: Vincent van Gogh was a Dutch artist. He was not famous in his lifetime. When he was 33, he moved to Paris. He wanted to paint people, but models were too expensive. He thought, "I don't have money for a model. What can I do?" So, Van Gogh started to paint himself. He painted 36 self-portraits. They are all different. Look at these two paintings. One is brighter than the other. Which one do you like?

Frida Kahlo was a Mexican artist. When she was six years old, she was very sick. Her right leg became weaker than her left leg. But she thought, "I will get well. I will help sick people like me." When she was 18, she was in a terrible bus accident. She stayed in the hospital for a long time. Kahlo said to herself, "I look weak. But I am stronger than anyone." So, Kahlo started to paint herself. She painted 55 self-portraits in her lifetime.

Mrs. Granger answered, "People give meanings to words." Nick asked, "How?" Mrs. Granger said, "You, me, and everyone in the country agreed on the meaning." Nick thought, "Really? I didn't agree." On the way home, Nick saw a pen on the street. He picked up the pen. He had an idea. "From today, your new name is frindle."

One day after class, Mrs. Granger called Nick. She said, "Frindle is not a real word. You and your classmates should stop using it." Nick said, "I know that you're not happy. I'm really sorry, but it's too late. Everyone is using it now."

The next morning, Mrs. Granger told the class, "Stop using frindle! Frindle is not a real word." But more and more students used it. Students in other schools started using it. Soon, students in the whole country were using it.
Dear Nick, Congratulations! Frindle is now a real word. I was on your side from the beginning. But every good story needs a "bad guy." I played that role. I hope that you understand...
